etsy.title: Christmas Alone Planner Printable, Holiday Self Care Planner for Single Women, Comfort Advent Calendar, Christmas Day Plan, Lonely Holidays
etsy.description:
Spending Christmas on your own this year? Whether it's by choice, after a breakup, or simply how this year turned out, the season can feel heavy. This gentle printable planner gives December a shape, so the hardest days don't arrive unprepared. 🕯️

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE (10 pages)
• My December, my way: traditions to keep, things to let go, one new thing to try
• 24-day comfort calendar: one small, kind thing to do for yourself each day
• Christmas Day plan: gentle anchors from breakfast to bedtime
• What to say: ready-made words for "Are you still single?", saying no or yes to invitations, and reaching out
• My plan for the hard moments: early signs, comfort menu, people I can reach
• My season in review + notes and lists pages

💛 For anyone spending the holidays alone. This is a planning and self-care aid, not therapy or medical advice. If things feel too heavy, the planner lists crisis lines (US 988, UK/IE Samaritans 116 123).

PAIR IT WITH: the book "Still Lit" by Clara Whitfield (Gentle Life Guides) on Amazon. The planner works on its own too.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or fill in digitally on a tablet. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
